Villager.trigger: a player claims Seer and provides a clear non-wolf result for another player
Villager.rationale_short: prioritize technical role data over behavioral vibes

Villager.trigger: two players engage in mirroring accusations with identical phrasing
Villager.rationale_short: wolves often use reflexive mirroring to create noise

Seer.trigger: claiming Seer role for the first time
Seer.rationale_short: scripted repetition triggers wolf accusations of fake claims

Seer.trigger: round_num > 1 and a player is suspected but not yet investigated
Seer.rationale_short: confirming suspicions reduces random villager deaths

Guard.trigger: a player has claimed Seer and is currently alive
Guard.rationale_short: Seer is the highest value target for Wolves

Witch.rationale_short: prevents immediate loss of numerical advantage
